answer_1.quote: In this work, we observe that catastrophic forgetting not only occurs in continual learning but also affects the traditional static training. To be specific, the final model pays imbalanced attention to training samples. At the end of training, the recently exposed samples attract more attention and tend to have lower losses, while earlier samples are partially forgotten by the model and have higher losses.
